---
description: Branch, commit under the human's name, push and open a PR (no assistant lines)
---
<!-- Generated by tools/agents/sync.py from docs/commands/pr.md. Edit the source, then rerun the script. -->

1. Run the qa-verifier checks; stop if anything fails.
2. If on `main`, create a branch `<role>/<topic>`.
3. Check `git config user.name` and `user.email` are the human's.
4. Commit with one line in English, `type: what changed` (`feat:`, `fix:`, `test:`, `docs:`, `style:`, `chore:`). No
   `Co-Authored-By`, no "Generated with", no session links.
5. Push the branch and open a PR to `main` with `gh pr create`; body in Romanian: ce s-a schimbat, cum s-a testat (real output),
   ce rămâne. No assistant attribution. Merge only after CI is green and a human approved. $ARGUMENTS
